data.one_liner: Responsive grid list widget using ListView.builder for efficient large lists
data.what_it_does: It builds a grid where each row has items of equal width and height, automatically adjusting the number of items per row based on screen width. The widget exposes spacing, margin, and min/max item constraints for flexible layouts.
use_when: Need a responsive grid that adapts to screen size
Working with large lists where performance matters
Want to avoid GridView’s overhead for simple grids
avoid_when: Items require varying heights per row
You need a fixed aspect ratio for every item
strengths: Easy to customize spacing and margins
weaknesses: All items share the same height per row
No built‑in fixed height or aspect ratio option

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides more layout options like staggered grids and fixed aspect ratios

data.minimal_example:
ResponsiveGridList(
  minItemWidth: 200,
  minItemsPerRow: 2,
  maxItemsPerRow: 4,
  children: List.generate(20, (i) => Card(child: Text('Item $i'))),
)
